description: This file defines an interface class IMemoryPartition with virtual methods for memory management, and declares operator overloads and template functions for creating and destroying objects using a custom memory partition. It serves as an abstraction layer for memory allocation strategies within a component of a larger system.

classes.name: IMemoryPartition
classes.description: An interface class that provides virtual methods for allocating and deallocating memory blocks, intended to be implemented for customized memory management within a system.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Virtual method to allocate a block of memory of specified size.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Virtual method to deallocate a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: operator new
methods.description: Overloaded global operator new to allocate memory for objects within a specified IMemoryPartition.

methods.name: operator delete
methods.description: Overloaded global operator delete to deallocate memory for objects within a specified IMemoryPartition.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Template function to construct an object of type T in a specified IMemoryPartition.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Template function to destroy an object of type T and deallocate its memory in the specified IMemoryPartition.
